title: Mastery of Adaptation
summary: Adapt to constructs whose changing forms alter resistances and combat abilities.
overview: Adapt to constructs whose changing forms alter resistances and combat abilities.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Identify the active form before committing your strongest attacks.
Favor cold against the fire form and fire against the ice form.
Keep extra healing available for the forms with rampage or flurry.
Pick up supporting constructs as they appear and adjust weapon choices to the current form.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
